newsitem.title: UK: UK budget to raise net taxes of 2 bln stg-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK budget to raise net taxes of 2 bln stg-paper.

text.p: UK Chancellor Gordon Brown's budget will include a rise in net taxes in the current year of more than two billion stg and significantly larger increases thereafter, the Financial Times said on Wednesday.
Brown will describe his budget as a "five-year deficit reduction plan," the paper said.
The budget, Labour's first in two decades, will be unveiled today.

The paper said the most contentious measures are expected to include the abolition of the 20 percent tax credit on dividend payments, a reduction in mortgage interest relief and a doubling to two percent in the stamp duty levied on sales of expensive homes.
A sharp increase in the duty on petrol and generous tax incentives for corporate investment also are likely, the Financial Times said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
